item.guhs.dubbel_gefrituurde_kaasknabbel: Back in the pan for another go. Why? Because it can, njeg.
item.guhs.driedubbel_gefrituurde_kaaskna: More grease than nibble. Your doctor quietly weeps.
item.guhs.kaaskroket.lore: Crispy outside, lava hot inside. Wait before biting.
item.guhs.frikandel_guhspeciaal.lore: With cheese sauce, nibble onions and wahoog curry. Nobody knows what is in it, and that is for the best.
item.guhs.bitterguhllen.lore: Round, crispy and looking at you a bit. With a dollop of mustard.
item.guhs.kaassoufflguh.lore: A crispy little pillow full of molten chonk.
item.guhs.patatje_kaassaus.lore: From the pan, into a paper cone, under the sauce. Wahoog.
item.guhs.patatje_vads.lore: With an extra layer of chonk, for the chonkers among us.
item.guhs.patatje_oorlog.lore: All the sauces fight for your attention, but they hug it out afterwards.
item.guhs.patatje_guhspeciaal.lore: Fried twice and golden with pride.
item.guhs.vetste_hap.lore: A tower of chonk. Fills your whole bar. Only for Indestructible Chonk Stomachs.
item.guhs.vetste_hap.feestje: WAHOOG! You finished The Chonkiest Bite! All of Guhland hears you burp. Njeg!
block.guhs.frying_pan.recept_onbekend: You don't know the recipe for %s yet. Ask the Snackbar Guh!
block.guhs.frying_pan.vetste_hap_nodig: The Chonkiest Bite: %s triple fried nibbles in your hand, %s croquettes, %s frikandels and %s grease in the pan
gui.guhs.knus.snackrecepten.patatje_vads: In the frying pan: a baked potato.
gui.guhs.knus.snackrecepten.patatje_oorl: In the frying pan: a poisonous potato (the pan takes the poison out, njeg).
gui.guhs.knus.snackrecepten.patatje_guhs: In the frying pan: fries with cheese sauce.
gui.guhs.knus.snackrecepten.kaaskroket.i: In the frying pan: a chunk of cheese.
gui.guhs.knus.snackrecepten.frikandel_gu: In the frying pan: a raw porkchop.
gui.guhs.knus.snackrecepten.bitterguhlle: In the frying pan: raw beef.
gui.guhs.knus.snackrecepten.kaassoufflgu: In the frying pan: a loaf of bread.
gui.guhs.knus.snackrecepten.vetste_hap.i: In the frying pan: 16 triple fried cheese nibbles in your hand, plus 4 cheese croquettes and 4 frikandels.
